newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks plummet amid EMU worries, eye France.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks plummet amid EMU worries, eye France.

text.p: Madrid stocks ended sharply lower on Friday as dealers took profits amid mounting worries over the future of the single currency, dealers said.
French election results will be a key driver next week, as will news on the Buba-Bonn gold standoff, they added.
The general index shed 8.67 points, 1.56 percent, to 547.47 and the Ibex fell 114.67 points, 1.8 percent, to 6,300.
French and German political woes were seen central in determining make-up of EMU, but dealers said Spanish stocks needed to correct after a spate of all-time highs in any case.
Telefonica dropped 120 pesetas to 4,170, Endesa down 330 pesetas to 11,040.
Dealers were not ruling out further losses on Monday if indeed the Socialists win the French poll as many now expect.
However the continued flow of investment funds entering the market should see gains later in the week, and the bourse outlook medium term remains positive, they said.
Most losses today were explained as simply a technical reaction, rather than the result of any specific corporate news, which was thin on the ground.
